name: transit-ops
description: TransitOps — fleet operations platform (Express API + React client + Copilot service)

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,copilot,web -c blue,magenta,green "npm --prefix server run dev" "npm run dev:copilot" "npm --prefix client run dev"
scripts.dev:services: concurrently -n api,copilot -c blue,magenta "npm --prefix server run dev" "npm run dev:copilot"
scripts.dev:copilot: cd copilot && uv run uvicorn main:app --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8100 --reload
